name: nft-subscription-marketplace
description: NFT subscription marketplace with HTS tokens and Hardhat contracts. Tokenize subscriptions and rent unused periods.

steps: This template uses Hardhat and deploys to Hedera testnet/mainnet.
+Set up your deployer account: cd packages/hardhat && yarn account:generate
+Fund your account with testnet HBAR from https://portal.hedera.com/faucet
+Initialize the HTS NFT collection: cd packages/hardhat && npx ts-node scripts/createCollection.ts
